fields.spec_version: Interlaken Protocol Definition Revision 1.2 (Cortina Systems + Cisco Systems)

lineage.summary: Initial Interlaken Protocol Definition by Cortina Systems and Cisco Systems.
Clarifications and errata to the framing/metaframe definition.
Current base protocol definition: 64B/67B, metaframe, burst framing, flow control.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Interlaken uses 64B/67B, a metaframe (Sync/Scrambler/Skip/Diagnostic) and Burst/Idle Control Words with channelized bursts; it has no MAC frame, no preamble/SFD and no MAC addresses.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Decoding Interlaken as Ethernet (MAC frames, preamble, 8B/10B or 64B/66B PCS) is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Interlaken is a multi-lane channelized SerDes framing protocol with metaframe and per-burst CRC-24; it is not a single-channel TVALID/TREADY handshake.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating Interlaken as AXI4-Stream misses the 64B/67B encoding, metaframe and lane bonding.
